orderings.single_max: One digit for 20 batches at [80,100); 100 mixed recovery batches.
orderings.single_late: One digit for 20 batches at [175,195); only 5 mixed recovery batches.
orderings.pair_max: Two digits for 40 batches at [140,180); 20 mixed recovery batches.
orderings.half_block: Five digits for 100 batches at [60,160); 40 mixed recovery batches.
orderings.staircase: Ten single-digit blocks of 16 batches at [20,180); 20 mixed batches before and after.
orderings.class_sorted: Ten single-digit blocks of 20 batches covering [0,200); no mixed recovery.
orderings.alternating_halves: Eight 25-batch blocks alternating two disjoint five-digit sets; no fully mixed segment.

training_schedule: Cyclic offsets (0,1,3,5) through the seven seen orderings, twice per update
selection: Minimize mean log(final dev loss) + mean log(dev trajectory loss) on seen orders only
paired_unit: Test episode seed, averaged over orders in scope and both policy seeds before differencing
evaluation: Fresh paired replay of all variants, using original MNIST official test split
